content.text: Now proposing the fallback-level narrowing of the Company-side exclusivity in 6.1.

input.summary: Limit Company-side exclusivity in Section 6.1 to 12 months and add automatic release on HDI performance failure
input.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook does not accept exclusivity binding us for an indefinitely renewing term with no performance-based exit, so we have limited Section 6.1 to twelve months from the Effective Date and provided that our restriction falls away automatically if HDI misses the Site operational dates or its service or performance obligations. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 and its exclusive right to the "Deerskin" branded site are unchanged.

ops.oldText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate
ops.newText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, for a period of twelve (12) months from the Effective Date, the Company shall not participate

ops.oldText: directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: directly to the consumer on the Internet. The Company's obligations under this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically, without penalty and without affecting any other provision of this Agreement, upon HDI's failure to have the Site fully operational by the date required under Section 1.6 or to meet any other service level, delivery date or performance obligation under this Agreement.
